Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the very first step by stating as a "Known starting point" that "The spouse most commonly associated with him is Jennifer Connelly." This was an unjustified assumption made without performing any search or gathering evidence first. The Planner should have started with a neutral search to verify who voices J.A.R.V.I.S. and then who their spouse is, rather than hallucinating or assuming the answer (Jennifer Connelly) at the outset. This premature assumption biased the entire subsequent search process, leading the agents to look for confirmation of a specific fact rather than discovering the truth.
